notes: Discovery Engine search input becomes unreliable after deduplication: — clicking "Deduplicate" in Proxy Sources calls `refreshSources()` which dispatches `setSources()` to Redux, triggering a component re-render. The search input was conditionally rendered via `{isDiscoveryOpen && (...)}`, which caused React to remove and re-add the input's DOM node during the re-render, permanently destabilizing it. Fix: replaced conditional rendering with CSS `hidden` class (keeps DOM nodes always mounted, hides via `display: none`), stabilized the `ref` callback by removing the unnecessary `isDiscoveryOpen` dependency from `useCallback`, and added a `useEffect` that focuses the input when the panel opens.
